name: morpheus
description: Morpheus is a research platform from North Star Systems Security Lab (NS3L).

scripts.ci:smoke:tool:buildroot: bash -lc 'cd tests && node ../apps/morpheus/dist/cli.js --json workflow run --name buildroot-build-ci'
scripts.ci:smoke:tool:microkit-sdk: bash -lc 'cd tests && node ../apps/morpheus/dist/cli.js --json workflow run --name microkit-sdk-build-ci'
scripts.ci:smoke:tool:qemu: bash -lc 'cd tests && node ../apps/morpheus/dist/cli.js --json workflow run --name qemu-build-ci'
scripts.ci:smoke:tool:sel4: bash -lc 'cd tests && node ../apps/morpheus/dist/cli.js --json workflow run --name sel4-fetch-patch-ci'
scripts.ci:smoke:tool:libvmm: bash -lc 'cd tests && node ../apps/morpheus/dist/cli.js --json workflow run --name libvmm-build-ci'
scripts.ci:pre-push: pnpm --filter @morpheus/app test:repo-structure && pnpm test:ci-config && pnpm lint && pnpm test
